title: Bogart H1 revenue falls 7.4% amid weak consumer demand
summary: The Bogart Group reported revenue of EUR 114.7 million in the first half of 2026, down 7.4% at current exchange rates and 5.3% on a like-for-like basis. Bogart attributed the decline to an unfavorable economic and geopolitical environment that continues to weigh on consumer spending, particularly in its retail business, where the group is also pursuing an ongoing network reorganization.
